meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 OpenClaw 的配置与任务到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想从 OpenClaw 换到 NanoClaw,又不想丢失现有配置。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2 while keeping your data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from OpenClaw to NanoClaw and want to keep your existing setup.

howto.what: 检测本机已有的 OpenClaw 安装，读出它的身份、渠道凭据、定时任务和配置，然后以对话方式带你逐项迁到 NanoClaw v2，每次改动先给你看过再写入。
howto.when: 当你提到 “migrate from openclaw”、“openclaw migration”、“import from openclaw” 等说法，或要把已有 OpenClaw 安装搬到 NanoClaw v2 时触发。

howto.what_en: Detects an existing OpenClaw install, reads its identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks and config, then walks you through migrating to NanoClaw v2, showing proposed changes before applying.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw", or when you have an OpenClaw install to move into NanoClaw v2.
